CIA bribing German media to spin news to support US interests - says top German editor

As sad as it may be, this article is not exaggerating. For a few decades after WW2 most news outlets were quite distanced from the idea of writing anything that could even remotely be considered propaganda. The exceptopn being shit tier tabloid journalism like the BILD, the german equivalent of the SUN, which has always been to the far right of what could be considered neutral. Sadly, the BILD is the most widely read "news"paper in Germany and it has several sister magazines (Welt, Computer BILD, Metal Hammer, etc) owned by the same coorporation - Axel Springer AG, equally as manipulating. Nowadays it's called PR when ministries of the government secretly pay the press to portray certain affairs in a certain light but there is no difference what so ever between PR and what we used to call propaganda. [3]

Not too long ago a former chief editor of the BILD was appointed chief editor of the Spiegel, a magazine widely considered more serious and honest. The result you can see on the cover in the above linked article.

The state financed television channels have recently been called out to be overwhelmingly onesided in the coverage of the Ukraine crisis. They confessed to that, though only in two posts on their website [1,2] and some comments in late night shows. They are quasi-tax funded to counter bribery or profit oriented broadcasting, every german household has to pay them 17,90 Euros every three months so they can keep up their "good work". Apparently that didn't work.

Without question, the media in the US is much worse when it comes to propaganda; after all the entire concept of post WW2 propaganda (aka Public Relations) was developed by Bernays [4] to aide a ruling class govern the people. But in the light of Germanys history one would think there would be a stronger opposition and outcry when it comes to manipulative politicians and media conglomerates.
